name: BLOB_LITERAL_TYPEOF
description: x'01ab' is a BLOB literal; typeof returns 'blob'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(x'01ab');

name: HEX_OF_BLOB_UPPERCASE
description: hex(x'01ab') returns uppercase '01AB'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT hex(x'01ab');

name: UNHEX_RECOVERS_BLOB
description: unhex('01ab') returns the matching BLOB; typeof = 'blob'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT length(unhex('01ab')), hex(unhex('01ab')), typeof(unhex('01ab'));

name: LENGTH_BLOB_BYTE_COUNT
description: length(blob) returns the byte count for BLOB values
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT length(x'01020304'), length(x'01'), length(x'');

name: OCTET_LENGTH_BLOB
description: octet_length(blob) returns the same byte count as length() for BLOB
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT octet_length(x'01020304'), octet_length(x'01'), octet_length(x'');

name: ZEROBLOB_TYPEOF_AND_HEX
description: zeroblob(N) yields an N-byte all-zero BLOB; hex() returns N*'00'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(zeroblob(4)), length(zeroblob(4)), hex(zeroblob(4));

name: BLOB_CONCAT_OPERATOR
description: BLOB || BLOB concatenates byte-wise; typeof of result is 'blob'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(x'01' || x'02'), hex(x'01' || x'02'), length(x'01' || x'02');

name: BLOB_ORDER_BYTEWISE
description: BLOB comparison is byte-wise lex; shorter prefix sorts first when bytes match
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT x'01' < x'02', x'02' < x'01', x'01' < x'0100', x'0100' < x'01';

name: BLOB_EQUALITY_SAME_BYTES
description: Identical BLOBs are equal regardless of hex-literal case in source
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT x'01ab' = x'01ab', x'01AB' = x'01ab';

name: BLOB_AFFINITY_INTEGER_COLUMN
description: BLOB inserted into INTEGER-affinity column keeps storage class 'blob'

name: BLOB_AFFINITY_TEXT_COLUMN
description: BLOB inserted into TEXT-affinity column also keeps storage class 'blob'

name: QUOTE_BLOB_HEX_LITERAL
description: quote(blob) renders X'...' literal with uppercase hex
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT quote(x'01ab'), quote(zeroblob(2));

name: UNHEX_INVALID_RETURNS_NULL
description: unhex on invalid hex input returns NULL (typeof = 'null')
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT unhex('xyz'), typeof(unhex('xyz'));

name: BLOB_GROUP_BY
description: GROUP BY a BLOB column treats identical byte sequences as one key

name: BLOB_INDEX_LOOKUP
description: Index over BLOB column supports equality lookup

name: BLOB_ORDER_WITH_NULL
description: ORDER BY on BLOB places NULL first (default ASC) then byte-wise

name: BLOB_VS_TEXT_DIFFERENT_TYPES
description: BLOB containing UTF-8 bytes for 'hello' does NOT compare equal to text 'hello'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT x'68656c6c6f' = 'hello', typeof(x'68656c6c6f'), typeof('hello');

name: EMPTY_BLOB_LENGTH
description: Empty BLOB x'' has typeof='blob' and length=0
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(x''), length(x''), hex(x'');

name: EMPTY_BLOB_ORDER
description: Empty BLOB sorts before any non-empty BLOB
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT x'' < x'00', x'' = x'', x'' < x'01';

name: CAST_TEXT_TO_BLOB
description: CAST('hello' AS BLOB) yields a BLOB of UTF-8 bytes
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(CAST('hello' AS BLOB)), hex(CAST('hello' AS BLOB)), length(CAST('hello' AS BLOB));

name: CAST_BLOB_TO_TEXT
description: CAST(blob AS TEXT) reinterprets bytes as text
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(CAST(x'68656c6c6f' AS TEXT)), CAST(x'68656c6c6f' AS TEXT);

name: JSON_REJECTS_BLOB
description: JSON functions reject BLOB inputs with 'JSON cannot hold BLOB values'
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT json_quote(x'01ab');
